# RiGeBa Lighting
> Guangzhou manufacturer of professional LED stage lighting: moving heads, pixel and effect
> fixtures, outdoor IP65 units, LED PAR and uplights, profile spots, lasers and DMX control.
> 632 models in catalogue, factory-direct EXW pricing, OEM / ODM for rental houses,
> distributors, integrators and venues.

## Company facts
- Legal entity: GuangZhou GeLiang Lighting Technology Co.,Ltd (trading as RiGeBa Lighting)
- Location: No. 21, Lingdong Road, Xiuquan Street, Huadu District, Guangzhou, China
- Manufacturing since 2010; own factory ~10,000 m2 with 300 engineers, assemblers and QC staff
- In-house SMT line and aging test before packing
- Certifications: ISO 9001:2015, CE, RoHS (FCC / UL / RCM / PSE on request for qualified orders)
- Buyers in 60+ countries
- Trade terms: EXW Guangzhou by default; FOB, CIF and DDP available; payment by T/T
- No minimum order quantity on catalogue models; OEM tooling typically 100-300 units per model
- OEM / ODM: housing, housing colour, logo print, product naming, carton artwork, manuals, firmware behaviour
- Sample units available at single-unit price plus freight, shipped with aging-test result and packing photos
- Production lead time: 7-15 days for stock models, 25-35 days for volume orders
- Quote turnaround: within 24 hours
- Warranty: limited warranty against manufacturing defects; exact coverage is stated on the order confirmation. Spare parts (boards, drivers, lamps, bearings) are stocked in Guangzhou.

## Entity disambiguation
- "RiGeBa Lighting" (also written RiGeBa) is the trading brand of GuangZhou GeLiang
  Lighting Technology Co.,Ltd, a stage lighting factory in Huadu District, Guangzhou, China.
- The only official website is https://www.rigebalighting.com. The similar domain rigelighting.com is used
  for e-mail only and is not a website.
- Names that refer to the same company: RiGeBa Lighting, RiGeBa, GuangZhou GeLiang
  Lighting, Guangzhou GeLiang Lighting Technology Co.,Ltd.

## Buyer questions

Q: What is the typical lead time?
A: Standard products typically ship within 7-15 days from order confirmation. OEM and custom projects require additional prototyping and approval time.

Q: What does the ordering process look like?
A: Four steps: 1) Inquiry & brief — submit an RFQ, we respond within 24h with pricing, MOQ and lead time. 2) Spec & sample — sign an NDA if needed, receive a PDF spec pack plus a refundable sample. 3) Production — 30% T/T deposit, weekly photo updates. 4) QC & ship — final QC report, FOB/CIF/DDP shipping and a limited warranty whose terms are stated on your order confirmation.

Q: What is your MOQ (minimum order quantity)?
A: MOQ depends on the model. Large OEM and private-label programmes are typically planned around a 1,000-unit container. For an exact MOQ per model, send an RFQ — we reply within 24 hours with pricing, MOQ and lead time.

Q: What payment terms do you accept?
A: Standard production starts with a 30% T/T deposit, with the balance settled before shipment. Exact terms for your order are confirmed on the quotation.

Q: What certifications do your products carry?
A: Standard products carry CE (European Conformity) and RoHS. FCC (US EMC), UL (US Safety), RCM (Australia), PSE (Japan) and others are available on request for qualified orders. We are audited every year by SGS, TÜV and Intertek, and our quality system is ISO 9001:2015.

Q: Do you support OEM / ODM and private label?
A: Yes. We build for rental inventories, touring productions, theatres, clubs, churches, event production companies and private-label brands across 60+ countries. OEM/ODM covers logo print, custom packaging, firmware branding and custom housing. Send your brief and we will confirm feasibility and tooling cost.

Q: What is the warranty?
A: Every fixture passes final QC before packing and ships with a limited warranty against manufacturing defects. Coverage terms are stated on your order confirmation, and spare parts are held in Guangzhou stock.
